content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) for various managerial positions across India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are available for Senior Manager and Assistant Manager posts in Port & Waterways and Coastal Modeling departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and fee payment is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time Graduate degree in Civil Engineering along with a Master's Degree in Marine Engineering & Management, Ocean Structures, or Structural Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Assistant Manager (Port & Waterways / Coastal Modeling) posts is 32 years, with admissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 600 plus applicable taxes.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RITES posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test, Document Verification, and a personal Interview round for eligible shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website www.rites.com under the Career section by filling out the form and uploading documents.

faq.question: Q9. When is the tentative written exam date?
faq.answer: The tentative written examination for RITES various posts recruitment is scheduled to be held on 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from INR 40,000 to INR 1,80,000 depending upon the specific post and managerial grade.
